thread:
maya: Quick idea 1: designate a "snack ambassador" for each week to restock basics (coffee, tea, filters, sugar) and tidy the shelf. volunteers?
travis: I can do next week. will bring extra tea. also pro tip: label opened containers with date.
sam: love this. can the ambassador get a tiny budget (like $15) so they don't always pay out of pocket?
kitchen-bot: Policy reminder: small office purchases under $20 can be expensed via the "office-supplies" form. react :money_with_wings: 
ella: @sam yes please, and maybe a shared checklist pinned to the fridge (filters, ground coffee, oat milk, napkins).
maya: I'll make a checklist template. travis next week, @travis would you prefer to swap with someone if youre busy?
travis: Yup, swap ok. I'll post the week I'm on the calendar.
sam: Also can we get a small magnet: "Ambassador: name / week" for the fridge? fun and visible.
kitchen-bot: Inventory status: ground coffee 2 bags, tea assortment low on peppermint, filters 12. Suggested action: restock peppermint tea.
ella: I'll pick up peppermint tea when I grab snacks tomorrow. and i'll bring a magnet.
maya: thanks! tiny governance note: ambassador shouldn't throw away labeled "leftovers" unless 48h old. helps prevent muffin massacre.
travis: Agree. Also, if you bring something communal, put a sticky note with allergy info if it has nuts.
sam: Amen to the sticky notes. Also shoutout to whoever refilled the napkins yesterday, you are the real MVP.
maya: OK I'll create a short signup doc and drop the link. Ambassador program starts Monday. :party_popper:
